item.text: The ResStock team recommends **1,000 or more samples** when no further specifics are known, because uncertainty levels off around 1,000 samples for many common quantities of interest. See [“How Many Samples are Required for this Analysis?”](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/resources/explanations/Number_of_samples.html#number-of-samples-when-analyzing-timeseries-results).
